rules.comparable: on_demand 是主口径；spot/serverless 按同一 live/非 floor/USD/每 provider min 规则可计算差值，但不能与整租 on-demand 混读；reserved/community/marketplace 因期限或 floor 语义不可比。
rules.quartiles: linear interpolation (n-1)*p; P25/P75 published only when n>=4
rules.published: gpus.json rate_card_median (includes serverless and non-USD); audit only, never used for diff
rules.dedup: one value per provider, taking the cheapest eligible rate
rules.diff: diff_pct = own_median / ext_median - 1; this is a methodology/sample gap, not a transaction price spread
rules.overlap_definition: overlap = intersection of our latest-day on-demand provider set for the card and GPU Economy's family provider set (H100 family = h100+h100-sxm+h100-pcie); overlap_count_match uses match_id only. Because this is a latest-day panel, H100/H200/A100 counts (16/12/12) differ from facts-external §9.4's historical-provider-pool counts (17/14/13).
rules.methodology_versions: own_methodology_version is AI Compute Economics'; methodology_version and ext_methodology_version refer to GPU Economy.
rules.changes: filtered and recomputed by AI Compute Economics; not the GPU Economy published figure
